prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Redesign the attached CapCut desktop screenshot into a complete, meticulously designed OpenCut desktop video editor in Simplified Chinese. The input image is a visual reference for familiar editing layout, compact density, dark gray materials, and timeline controls; create an original OpenCut interface, removing all red annotation boxes and all CapCut logos, Pro, AI, social sharing features. Output one high-resolution landscape 2560x1600 design image, straight-on pixel-perfect software screen, no laptop, no perspective, no decorative backdrop. It must look like a credible shipping professional editing app with clean crisp typography and exact aligned geometry, NOT a marketing slide.
At top a slim 38px design annotation strip outside the app: "01 / 工作台总览" left and "OpenCut · 设计稿 · 示例数据" right.
Application top bar: simple OpenCut mark, project name "海岸慢行", saved check "已保存", right compact text-icon controls "编辑历史", "导出记录", single turquoise primary "导出".
Below three-panel layout, left resources 30%, central player 48%, right inspector 22%; upper workspace occupies 62% of remaining screen, multitrack timeline 38%. Dense but clear neutral charcoal #171819 #202123 #292b2e surfaces, border #383b3e, near-white text, secondary #a4a9af, restrained turquoise #55d4ca accent. Thin consistent outline icons. Chinese UI 13-14 logical pixels, labels 12 minimum. 6px panel corner radius, 4px gutters, 12px inner padding. No purple gradients, excessive rounded pills, giant whitespace or card descriptions.
Left top horizontal icon tabs: "素材 音频 文字 字幕 图形 特效 转场". 素材 selected. Slim secondary vertical categories "全部 视频 音频 图片". Search row + compact "导入" button. Main area 3-column grid of real photographic thumbnail cards with coastal footage, boats, tropical beach, sea rocks, walking figures. Seven cards. 16:9 thumbs, name in one line beneath, duration small overlay lower left; no persistent action rows beneath cards. Only one hovered card displays a discreet circular + in its bottom right and ellipsis in top right, each visually 24px and roomy enough to hit. Selected card has thin turquoise border. Bottom tiny resource count.
Center header "播放器" with "时间轴" active source indicator. Main 16:9 cinematic photographic preview of a calm tropical coast, stylish white title inside video "海岸慢行" with small subtitle "把时间交给海风", correctly within safe margins. Preview centered and large without stretching. Compact bottom transport row: time "00:08:12 / 00:42:00", previous-frame, play, next-frame centered; volume, fit, full-screen right. No redundant preview/save/copy buttons clutter.
Right inspector top context "画面" active, "声音" second. Name "海边漫步.mp4". Compact aligned rows and paired numeric fields. Section "变换" expanded with scale "100%", uniform lock; position X "0" Y "0"; rotation "0°"; opacity "100%" slider. Small reset per section. "裁剪" and "混合" collapsed; "片段信息" with in/out and duration one compact row. Keyframe diamond beside animatable properties. No giant blank forms.
Timeline top one 38px compact toolbar: undo redo, divider, split scissors, trash, divider, snap active, ripple active. Right fit timeline button, minus, slim horizontal zoom slider with small rounded rectangular thumb, plus. No Move/Trim/Add redundant text buttons. Ruler 00:00, 00:05, 00:10, 00:15, 00:20, 00:25, 00:30, 00:35, 00:40 aligned exactly above tracks. Left fixed headers 112px with small lock/eye/sound controls. Five compact tracks: 标题 (purple text chips, one "海岸慢行"), 主画面 (wide photographic filmstrip clips), 叠加画面 (two short chips), 效果 (one teal muted bar "模糊"), 配乐 (teal waveform with gain envelope). One video clip selected with thin white border and left/right trim handles. A small crossfade capsule visibly straddles exactly one adjacent video seam, not floating in empty space. White playhead head on ruler, vertical 1px line across tracks at 8.48s. Scrollbar at bottom has thumb width proportional to visible duration; do not add a second giant slider. Full timeline content inside bounds, no overlaps or cut off labels. Show enough tracks for usable space.
Bottom design caption outside app, only one line: "浏览在左 · 预览居中 · 参数在右 · 编辑在轨道". 
Constraint: reference content photos are replaced with generic generated coastal footage. Do not imply current software already implements this. No download control in editing history. All text must be legible Simplified Chinese.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create the second image of a coherent OpenCut desktop editor design set, matching the attached reference's charcoal, turquoise, crisp Chinese typography, flat professional software appearance and thin icons. This is a high fidelity design specification board, NOT a screenshot claiming implemented functionality. Landscape 2560x1600, no perspective. Header outside panels: "02 / 资源卡片与按钮规则" and small "OpenCut · 设计稿 · 示例数据".
Organize six neatly aligned zoomed resource panels in a 3 columns x 2 rows grid, fully legible Chinese, each showing a realistic compact tab view. Top left 媒体: search, import, three coastal photo thumbnails, filenames and duration below/overlay; default card has no buttons; hovered card shows ellipsis top-right and + bottom-right WITHIN image, not protruding; selected card turquoise outline. Top middle 文字与字体: search, category tabs 项目字体 / 字体库, a prominent "默认文字" card plus three real distinctly styled Chinese "海岸慢行" font sample cards labelled 思源黑体 / 思源宋体 / 马善政楷体; hovering a font shows small action "应用" with tooltip "应用到：海岸慢行", NOT + (plus is only new object). No selection: disabled 应用 with short tooltip "先选择文字片段". Show a small loading font row grey placeholder labelled "字体加载中". Font card remains visual preview, no extra full-width buttons. Top right 特效: 3 square photo cards using same coast sample with light, medium, strong blur labelled "轻柔模糊" "适中模糊" "明显模糊"; selected middle has turquoise border; hovering has small check/apply arrow tooltip "应用到：海边漫步". Tiny top mode control "片段效果 / 效果图层"; + only when adding an effect layer. Explain in tiny compact footer "落到片段：附着效果 · 落到效果轨：区间图层".
Bottom left 转场: 3 same-style thumbnail cards illustrating crossfade between coast and boat labelled "快速 · 0.25秒", "平滑 · 0.5秒", "舒缓 · 1秒". Tiny target line "当前接缝：海边漫步 → 帆船出海". On-hover apply icon and tooltip "应用到所选接缝". No giant demo image, no adjacency dropdown or duration form below cards. Body text small "拖到两段相邻画面的接缝". Bottom middle 音频: searchable compact rows with a play audition icon left, title "海风轻语", waveform, duration "00:42", and + hover at right, no full separate playback control row below each entry. 3 rows: 海风轻语 / 浪花 / 轻快脚步. One playing row shows pause, turquoise waveform fill. Bottom right 图形: 3x2 visual thumbnail grid of real shapes circle/rectangle/star, Chinese flag, blue flag, simple original abstract mark. Labels one line. + overlay appears only hovered item. Categories "基础形状 国旗 标记". No generic flag placeholder in every card.
At bottom one compact horizontal state strip: five visually clear card miniatures labelled "默认" "悬停" "选中" "拖动" "不可用"; dragging miniature with pointer and translucent ghost; unavailable miniature has loading/error emblem and disabled action. Below exactly three compact rules: "单击只预览，不改工程" / "＋新增，应用按钮修改选中对象" / "操作浮在卡片内，下方只留名称".
Exact consistent UI spacing 8px grid gaps, 6px radius, 12-14px equivalent Chinese font, no huge voids. Use generic generated coastal images matching reference. No unsupported fancy effects, no Pro, AI, subscriptions, no downloading in edit history. All panels clearly distinct and fit inside board.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create board 03 of the attached OpenCut design family. Match reference charcoal surfaces, restrained turquoise accents, thin white outline icons, clean Chinese typography, high density. High-resolution landscape 2560x1600 design specification image, crisp legible, no device perspective. Title "03 / 轨道、拖拽与属性" small "设计稿 · 状态示例".
Arrange top 55% as one enlarged working timeline with left track headers, ruler, short 3 video clips plus text/effect/audio lanes and right inspector (~25%). Timeline design must be geometrically precise. Ruler 00:00 00:05 00:10 00:15 00:20. Two adjacent video clips A coast from 0–10s, B boat10–20s; transition box centered exactly at10s, duration0.5s, white selection outline; inspector right title "交叉淡化" and compact fields "时长 0.50 秒", "前一片段 海边漫步", "后一片段 帆船出海", only appropriate small delete and reset icons. A small translucent crossfade resource ghost follows cursor just above the seam, turquoise seam target and tooltip "释放以添加转场 · 0.5秒". Pointer ghost must not obscure inspector. No duplicated "添加" footer forms. Text track purple, audio waveform teal. Playhead white at8s. Narrow visible bottom scrollbar and top toolbar containing undo, redo, split, delete, snapping, ripple, fit, minus, slim zoom slider with rectangular thumb, plus. Zoom and scrolling visibly separate.
Below left a 2x2 grid of four compact state examples: (1) "素材落轨" photo ghost spans exactly the outlined free interval of compatible video lane with destination time badge "00:12:00"; (2) "字体替换" font ghost "Aa" over purple selected text clip "海岸慢行", tooltip "替换字体，保留文字与时长"; (3) "锁定轨道" locked lane dim, prohibited cursor, tooltip "轨道已锁定", ghost not accepted; (4) "边缘滚动" clip ghost at right edge, edge highlighted, outward arrows and compact note "停在边缘持续滚动 · Esc取消". Show no save on hover; ghost dashed outline.
Below right three stacked narrow compact inspector snapshots with identical field geometry: "文字" content multiline "把时间交给海风", font chooser, size 72, align buttons, fill swatch; "声音" volume -6dB slider plus gain diamond and fade-in/out fields; "多选 · 3个片段" shows common opacity100% and position with mixed em dash values. One miniature 20px short clip has expanded trim hit area indicated with dashed outline and magnified adjacent edge handles so short clips remain editable.
Footer separate from UI contains exact rules in three rows (12px equivalent): "缩放：滚轮以指针为锚点；滑杆以播放头为锚点" / "拖动即时反馈；松手提交一次；Esc取消" / "右侧改参数，轨道改位置与时长，资源区不重复操作". Keep all Chinese readable, each example bounded, no overlaps, no misleading actual success claims.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create board04 of coherent OpenCut design set matching attached charcoal/turquoise desktop editor. Landscape high-resolution2560x1600, crisp professional Chinese UI design, no perspective. Title outside: "04 / 编辑历史与导出" right "设计稿 · 示例数据". Three carefully aligned columns, left27%, middle29%, right44%, generous enough readable but compact internal spacing. Background muted dark app surface, panels flat not giant pill cards.
LEFT: narrow right-side drawer titled "编辑历史" with close×; small segmented "修改记录 / 已保存版本"; compact undo redo icons near header; rows each ~50px logical: "调整模糊强度" and time "今天 14:32"; "替换标题字体"14:28; "添加交叉淡化"14:25; "修剪海边漫步"14:20; "导入3个素材"14:12. Each row has brief object subtitle, one disclosure caret and contextual ellipsis. Latest row small 当前 badge. Second row expanded exact before/after "字体：思源黑体 → 马善政楷体". Lower inline revision-preview state, not overlaying previous rows: heading "查看已保存版本" time14:25; small coast preview and text "只读预览"; buttons "返回当前版本" secondary and "恢复此版本" subdued primary. Absolutely NO download button/icon anywhere in this LEFT editing-history panel. At bottom outside left tiny rule "历史只管查看、撤销和恢复".
MIDDLE: compact export-settings dialog titled "导出视频" close×, small coast thumbnail at top left and name input "海岸慢行.mp4", one-line metadata "00:42 · 1920×1080 · 25fps". Dense paired fields: 格式 MP4 / 编码 H.264; 分辨率1080p / 帧率25fps; 画质高 / 包含音频 checked. Minimal advanced accordion closed "更多设置". Output destination row "浏览器下载" with folder icon. Footer fixed buttons "取消" and turquoise "开始导出". Entire settings dialog height only around420 logical pixels, no huge paragraph gaps. Below separated progress example small panel "正在导出 · 海岸慢行.mp4" 62% progress bar, "关闭窗口后继续导出"; footer "取消导出" and "收起". Below small success panel compact check "导出完成", filename, buttons "下载视频" and "查看导出记录". Each result consistent no simultaneous fictitious real statuses within one panel, state labels outside.
RIGHT: broader panel title "导出记录", one header only, search input and compact filters "全部 进行中 已完成 失败". Compact table headers "文件 / 规格 / 状态 / 操作", rows with tiny thumbnail and readable truncated filename, date second line, mp41080p25fps42s small metadata, status and contextual action at right. Row1 海岸慢行.mp4 今天14:35 已完成 下载 icon+text. Row2 海岸慢行_横版.mp4 今天14:20 正在导出62% 取消. Row3 海岸慢行_配乐.wav 昨天18:04 已完成 下载. Row4 海岸慢行_高画质.mp4 昨天17:50 失败 with 展开 chevron, expanded two-line error "保存失败，请检查可用空间" with "重试" and "详情" small buttons. Row5 long filename "海岸慢行_海边合影与日落精选版…" 昨天17:30 已完成 下载. No impossible overflow. Footer compact "5条记录". Below a small separate empty-state variant with understated icon "还没有导出记录" and single "去导出" action.
Overall row target48–56px logical, typography13-14px, clear primary-secondary hierarchy, titles16px, 12px card padding, 8px gaps, standard 28px controls. Avoid verbose explanatory paragraphs in product panels. No giant card whitespace. Correct stable UI borders, no duplicated nested panel titles.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create final board05 in OpenCut high-fidelity design family matching attached reference charcoal/turquoise surfaces, sharp fine Chinese text, compact editing UI. Landscape2560x1600 design board, title "05 / 字幕、预览与辅助面板" right "设计稿 · 示例数据". 2 rows, 3 columns of framed interface closeups, six panels with numbered concise labels outside each.
Panel1 top-left "字幕编辑": compact caption-resource header "字幕", small import icon; list of three captions with start/end columns and editable text. Selected turquoise row "00:06.00 00:09.50 一起去海边", other rows "把脚步交给海风" and "山海有约，下次再出发". Buttons only header "识别字幕" and "导入字幕"; no duplicate row button strips. Mini timeline beneath shows aligned purple caption segments with selected one. Right mini inspector swatches font size48 center alignment. One caption active is visually consistent in list and timeline. Footer note outside "选中字幕：列表、轨道、属性同步".
Panel2 top-middle "素材预览": compact large coastal photo 16:9, top source pill "素材预览 · 海边漫步.mp4" and "返回时间轴" icon+text. Bottom standard transport play, time "00:03 / 00:15", volume. In/out handles on mini scrub bar at2s and10s, times "入点00:02 出点00:10", one compact "插入所选范围" action. Product control not repetitive add/place button rows. Tiny external note "预览不移动时间轴播放头".
Panel3 top-right "画布设置": small dialog "画布与背景"×, ratio presets16:9 selected,9:16,1:1; paired resolution fields1920×1080 linked; fps25; color space sRGB; background color swatch black and opacity100%; small preview frame shows safe area guides; bottom compact "取消" and "应用". No huge margins.
Panel4 bottom-left "识别与空状态": three compact stacked small state panels: blank caption list with title "还没有字幕", short "从声音识别，或导入字幕文件", actions "识别字幕" "导入字幕"; processing state "正在识别字幕" with progress48% and cancel; failed state "识别未完成" short "保留原有字幕，可稍后重试" button重试. No cloud/AI account claims.
Panel5 bottom-middle "选中与菜单": show context-sensitive inspector modes side by side small: empty selection titled "项目" with project name, resolution1920×1080,25fps,duration42s; selected clip inspector titled海边漫步 with compact transforms. Beneath one realistic timeline right-click menu "分割片段 ⌘B", "复制 ⌘C", "创建副本 ⌘D", separator, "删除片段 ⌫"; separate resource ellipsis menu "查看素材信息", "在时间轴中定位", "从素材库移除". Destructive names must distinguish clip from library.
Panel6 bottom-right "窄窗口 · 1280×720": miniature complete editor showing media pane 25%, player50%, inspector25%, timeline lower35%, visible header and all bottom controls. Content stays inside panel no overlaps. Below compact tokens specification swatches neutral/turquoise/purple and rows "控件高度28–32px", "图标24px · 命中区28px", "默认间距8px · 分组间距12px", "字号12–14px，长文本省略可查看完整". Clearly mark the tiny editor as layout specification, not legible full screen. All other panels clearly legible.
No image-generation weird overlapping boxes; crisp geometric hierarchy. Avoid extra unsupported features, no marketing slogans, no download in editing history. Every panel wholly visible, no clipping or browser chrome.
